name: cc-blender-skill
description: Comprehensive Blender skill plugin for Claude Code with harmonized multi-skill orchestration, reference-locked reconstruction, multiview validation, repair optimization, UV/texturing, look-dev, animation, and export workflows.
author: RobLe3 (with Claude)

requires.blender-mcp: official Blender MCP add-on (Blender extensions platform, lab_blender_org/mcp)

skills.name: text-to-blender
skills.description: Top-level entry point. Routes natural-language Blender requests to the appropriate sub-skill(s) and sequences them.

skills.name: blender-skill-harmonizer
skills.description: Meta-orchestrator that harmonizes Blender skills, resolves precedence/contract conflicts, and defines sequential/parallel handoffs.

skills.name: quality-refinement-autoloop
skills.description: Self-refinement loop for subpar Blender outputs: diagnose failure, acquire/refine generic skills, sanitize lessons, validate, update docs/versioning, and prepare release commit/push when requested.

skills.name: blender-pro-workflow
skills.description: Multi-phase pipeline guidance — scene assembly order, critique protocols, recovery patterns.

skills.name: blender-modeling
skills.description: Mesh creation, primitives, hard-surface modeling, modifier stacks, bmesh edits.

skills.name: blender-materials
skills.description: PBR materials via Principled BSDF — metals, glass, plastic, fabric, skin, procedural patterns.

skills.name: blender-lighting
skills.description: Three-point, HDRI, studio, dramatic, outdoor lighting setups.

skills.name: blender-cameras
skills.description: Cameras, focal length, depth of field, composition, animated cameras (orbit, dolly, push-in).

skills.name: blender-rendering
skills.description: Cycles vs EEVEE, samples, denoising, color management, animation rendering.

skills.name: blender-animation
skills.description: Keyframes, F-curves, easing, shape keys (visemes), drivers, NLA actions.

skills.name: blender-export
skills.description: Export to glTF/GLB, FBX, OBJ, USD, STL with target-platform settings.

skills.name: wireframe-to-3d
skills.description: Convert 2D orthographic wireframe drawings to parametric 3D models via image processing → Bezier fitting → Blender curves → mesh → glTF.

skills.name: reference-to-3d
skills.description: Template/branding/orthographic-reference locked 3D reconstruction with source analysis and overlay validation.

skills.name: blender-uv-texturing
skills.description: UV unwrap/projection, atlas mapping, alpha decals, baking, lightmaps, and texture-pack validation.

skills.name: reference-analysis-validator
skills.description: Source manifest, mask/component analysis, overlay validation, IoU/SSIM/bbox/centroid gates for 1:1 reconstruction.

skills.name: contour-to-mesh
skills.description: Generate Blender mesh surfaces from extracted 2D contours/masks before adding shallow depth.

skills.name: orthographic-registration
skills.description: Register front/side/back/top references into a shared coordinate contract for depth-accurate reconstruction.

skills.name: multiview-constraint-solver
skills.description: Checks whether orthographic references can be satisfied by one rigid 3D model and emits canonical source policy when views conflict.

skills.name: atlas-uv-fitting
skills.description: Detect atlas/decal regions and map each structural part to correct UV rectangles/projections.

skills.name: closed-surface-uv-coverage
skills.description: Audit and enforce full visible-surface texture coverage for closed/extruded assets, including back caps and sidewalls, before look-dev or animation acceptance.

skills.name: mascot-logo-reconstruction
skills.description: Top-level fail-gated workflow for 1:1 brand mascot/logo reconstruction from references and textures.

skills.name: multiview-fit-loop
skills.description: Closed-loop render/compare/adjust/re-render validation across front/side/back/top templates.

skills.name: fit-repair-optimizer
skills.description: Turns validation failures into sequential/parallel source-of-truth alignment repair queues with dependency gates.

skills.name: reference-look-calibration
skills.description: Reference-image look calibration for lighting/material/render/aura matching using color and mask metrics.

skills.name: source-part-segmentation
skills.description: Segment overlapping source/template/atlas parts into per-structural-component masks before contour mesh generation.

skills.name: texture-driven-mesh-fitting
skills.description: Reshape mesh boundaries to fit texture-atlas/source contours 1:1 instead of stretching textures onto approximate geometry.

skills.name: landmark-fit-repair
skills.description: Validate and repair named feature landmarks such as tips, shell corners, face features, aura rings, and depth markers.

skills.name: texture-state-animation
skills.description: Layered, registered, export-aware texture/material state animation without ugly full-image crossfades.

skills.name: orbital-hud-motion
skills.description: Source-derived circular/HUD/orbital motion design for halos, rings, dots, dashes, and aura elements.

skills.name: animation-quality-gate
skills.description: Contact-sheet and motion QA gate for validating texture morphs, HUD animation, silhouette stability, and export truth.

complementary.name: ra100/blender-claude-plugin
complementary.rationale: 8 generalist Blender reference skills (geometry-nodes, shader-nodes, compositor, etc.). Complementary — they teach Blender's API; we teach how to use it for tasks.

complementary.name: Dev-GOM/blender-toolkit
complementary.rationale: Specializes in Mixamo retargeting via custom WebSocket addon. Coexists fine with this plugin — different port, different focus.
